heading: Men Of God Available on our Prayer Lines

partners.name: Prophet Paul Njonga
partners.verse: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
partners.bio:
Brother Paul Njonga is a Minister of Glory Of God International Prophetic And Deliverance Ministry, based in Germany. From the inception of God Is Able, Brother Paul has been an unwavering mentor and supporter, deeply committed to the mission of spreading the Good News of our Lord Jesus Christ.

A dedicated Christian, Brother Paul is on a divine mission to share the love and power of God with all. He is readily available to fellowship and pray with anyone seeking the transformative presence of God in their lives.

partners.name: Prophet John Litoti
partners.verse: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes: first to the Jew, then to the Gentile.
partners.bio:
Prophet John is the visionary leader of Report Change International Ministry. Through his steadfast commitment, countless lives have been transformed by the power of faith.

As a Minister of the Holy Ghost, Prophet John is fervently engaged in mission work, tirelessly spreading the Gospel of Jesus Christ. His mission is to inspire individuals to embrace a life of renewal through faith in Christ, encouraging them to be born again and dedicate their lives to His service.

Prophet John is readily accessible through our prayer lines, eager to extend fellowship and join in prayer with all who seek spiritual guidance and support.
